shellCommands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md

rg --files -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!.agents/**'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!'"\\.git/**'
cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text Switch Select ThemeProvider useTheme
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md
cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts AGENTS.md

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text Switch Select ThemeProvider useTheme

rg -n '"'^#.*(Button|Select|Switch|Text |Theme)|useThemeType|useTheme|onUpdate|ThemeProvider'"' /tmp/uikit-7-docs.md | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh yagr
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check
cat package.json
rg -n 'setScales|new Yagr|dispose|setTimeout|setInterval|clearTimeout|clearInterval|disconnect|cancelAnimationFrame' src

npm test
git diff --check'
